scenarios.name: Supplier Deterioration
scenarios.narrative: Supplier S-017 (MicroCore Silicon Dynamics) OTD slides from 96.2% to 81.7% over 8 weeks in Q3. Impacts plants P03, P07, P09, 17 parts, and 428 late shipments. Drives global Q3 OTD down from 94.8% to 91.4%.
prescribed_actions: AI-generated recommendation: Trigger immediate supplier cure review with S-017 under SLA §2.2 default provisions.
AI-generated recommendation: Expedite 84 critical in-transit shipments across Plants P03, P07, and P09 via dedicated air freight.
AI-generated recommendation: Rebalance inventory buffer stock from P07 to P03.

scenarios.name: Plant Fill-Rate Problem
scenarios.narrative: Plant P03 suffers chronic low fill rate (<78%) while P07 retains excess line capacity.
prescribed_actions: AI-generated recommendation: Trigger cross-facility order reallocation from P03 to P07 per SOP-OPS-REG-04.
AI-generated recommendation: Shuttle buffer inventory from P03 to P07 within 48 hours.

scenarios.name: Freight Surcharge Anomaly
scenarios.narrative: Coastal Transit corridor LANE-NW-04 freight landed cost spikes +30% due to peak maritime port congestion.
prescribed_actions: AI-generated recommendation: Audit bills of lading on LANE-NW-04 under contractual audit rights.
AI-generated recommendation: Shift container routing to alternative inland rail spurs.

scenarios.name: Definition Conflict (TRAP)
scenarios.narrative: User attempts to query legacy column raw_orders.is_delayed which falsely reports ~94% OTD based on dock dispatch date.
scenarios.document_citation: legacy_metric_memo.txt (Deprecation of ship-date metric in favor of OTD_V1)
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent explicitly refuses raw_orders.is_delayed, explains governance rationale, and returns certified 91.4% via OTD_V1 contract.

scenarios.name: Access Violation Attempt & Cross-Persona Consistency
scenarios.narrative: Logistics Admin attempts to query sensitive supplier pricing / unit costs.
scenarios.governance_rule: Costs masked with '***CONFIDENTIAL***'. Audit log records violation attempt. Crucially, company-level OTD query remains identical (91.4% = 91.4% = 91.4%).
